---

### Install

1. Download the `.zip` below and unzip the whole folder anywhere.
2. Run `umayu.exe`. It isn't signed, so Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"*: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Setup opens on the first run: load a `.umalord.json` profile (drag it onto the window), or click the umas and cards you own.

Needs Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. This zip was built and tested by GitHub Actions from the tagged source.
